name: pkdns
title: PKDNS Resolver
tagline: Resolve Pkarr public keys to DNS records
description: Paste a Pkarr public key (52 z-base32 characters, or a pk: or pubky address) and see the DNS records its owner published on the Mainline DHT. Every relay answer is checked in the app against the key's Ed25519 signature, so a relay is never trusted. Also looks up ordinary domain names over DNS over HTTPS, and keeps favorites, recent keys, a resolve history with charts, and your relay list.
releaseNotes: First version: the PKDNS Resolver extension as a Ghostly app, with signature checks of every relay answer and DNS over HTTPS lookups.
